steps.content: Your group falls back, fighting as you go, and only realizes where they are when the dim tunnels give way to a glittering, ornate cavern.
In here, the coin bank uses everything—pillars, steps, whatever's around—to bounce off and change direction, springing at new targets way more nimbly than something that big should be able to.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ****, since when does a coin bank know how to move like that?!

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Meow!
It surges forward with nothing held back, and the Sinners waver under the onslaught. But to you, this is the moment. The perfect opening, laid bare.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now, Murphy!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: I-I got it! When it turns left... <color=#fb9259>it's gonna work!</color>

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Meow?!
The instant Murphy's words fade, your shackles release their grip on her. The coin bank, as though suddenly robbed of all traction, skids wildly and crashes straight into the wall beside it.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Nice! My turn!
Seizing the opening, she flips behind it in one fluid motion and looses arrow after arrow into the coin bank's back.
A sharp crack rings out as a slender fissure snakes across the coin bank's surface.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Meoww—Wait! Wait! Stop hitting me, meow!
The whole hall suddenly goes dead quiet.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...You can talk?!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Why didn't you say anything yesterday?!

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: You didn't give me a chance to talk yesterday either, meow! You just attacked me the second you saw me! And then you tricked me into crashing into the wall, do you know how long it took to pry myself out, meow?!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...I mean, you're the one who couldn't stop yourself. That's not on me.
Murphy hides behind you, poking her head out to chime in.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Th-that's not the point, meow!
It lies where it has fallen, its four stubby legs paddling uselessly at the air. There is something almost pitiable in the sight.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Who are you? And why do you keep coming after us?

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: I am the most proper, most law-abiding, most legally-minded Wealth Watcher in the whole world, meow!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Wow. Three lies in one sentence. I gotta hand it to you, that's a whole new level of shameless.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Get to the point.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: ...I wasn't trying to cause trouble for you before, meow! I've been looking for my lost <color=#fb9259>shiny!</color>

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Shiny?

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Hmm... now that I'm getting a closer look at you... you seem kinda familiar. Hmm... nah, must be imagining things, meow.
The huge cat-shaped coin bank gives itself a shake, its gaze shifting away from Murphy.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: That shiny is my heaven-sent investment fund, meow! I even remodeled my eyes to match it. See? Just like it, meow!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Even monsters get robbed nowadays? Guess things are rough all over.
You look at its eyes, and recognition clicks into place. They're the exact same as that greeting gift the Ring Research Institute supervisor gave you.

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: You'll have to forgive my students. Hopeless bookworms, the lot of them. Not an ounce of field experience between them. Terribly sorry for the awkward showing!

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: Now then! This is the Ring Research Institute's most prized achievement in recent months. Though I'll admit... compared to what a certain genius can whip up, it's little more than a trinket, haha... But please, accept it as a token of our goodwill!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Due to the Mania field's unusual properties, we can't directly intervene with it from above ground. The most we can do is slow its rate of expansion.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You'll need to locate that unstable experimental substance and neutralize its effects.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Where is it now?

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: I'm not telling you...
The words are only half out when it catches the weight of your stares—everyone, fixed on it, fierce and unblinking.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Just kidding, meow... I went sniffing around the slime village earlier, and all those slimes said it was that <color=#fb9259>alchemy geezer</color> next door who swiped it, meow!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Alchemy geezer?

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Yeah! The guy holed up in the workshop down below! Always waving around spoons and tongs, muttering about equivalent exchange and the Sage's Stone and turning stuff into gold, meow!

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: We gotta hurry, meow. My shiny might already be his next test subject!
[Scene Change]
The way to the lower level still winds through the sprawling candy forest, yet today, the woods bear an unmistakably different air...

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Meowww! Since when are there traps here?! I've walked through this place a hundred times and never had a problem, meow... What's the deal today?!
The coin bank's pitiful wails ring out one after another, while your group, by unspoken agreement, collectively averts its gaze.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: W-wait! Something's off!

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Nothing's off, meow. I used to stroll through here like it was my own backyard. Those were just little accidents—
Crack.
It barely gets the words out before one of its stubby little legs steps on something. It freezes up, then carefully lifts its paw to check what's underneath.
Okay, good. Just a mushroom.
The coin bank heaves a deep sigh of relief just as the analyzer Norma left you flickers to life, as if on cue.

<size=55><color=#fb9259>Startleshroom</color></size>


A low-growing fungus found at the edges of the Mania field. Soft and harmless in appearance, yet when <color=#fb9259>stepped on</color>, shaken, or exposed to bright light, it instantly compresses the air sacs inside its cap and <color=#fb9259>blasts out a high-pressure air jet</color> to drive away approaching creatures.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Figures. Newcomers never know how things work around here.
EMP shakes her head, letting out a bitter chuckle. Yet her hands never pause; she seizes a vine and lashes herself firmly to the ground. The others, seeing her example, quickly do the same.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Meow?!

The coin bank barely has time to puzzle over the strange behavior of the humans before it, then the mushroom beneath its foot bursts, unleashing a violent blast of compressed air. Prepared as you are, the sheer force of the gale still threatens to tear you from your footing.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Aaaah—can't—stay up—!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: The wind—is—so strong—!

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: This—is—nuts—meow!
[Black Screen Transition]
It is not until evening falls that you finally stumble out of the forest, drained beyond measure.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Huff... huff... Next time, someone else can be the guide, meow... I'm retired.
Beyond the bridge stretches a landscape that resembles the outskirts of some workshop, punctuated at intervals by a low, rumbling roar like furnace fire exhaling in the distance.
Gazing upon this utterly transformed area, your thoughts drift uneasily to the real Bureau, and what state it must be in now.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: So... this is where he does his remodeling? Hmm... pretty interesting!

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Yep, meow.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: And he's the worst. The more you try to talk sense into him, the more he thinks you'd make great test material, meow.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...What is this, a budget villain origin story?
Further on, a massive door looms at the end of the corridor. Through its seams seeps an unbroken crimson glow, and the faint pulse of heat radiates from the floor beneath your feet.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: It's... kinda hot in here.
You have barely raised your hand when an exaggerated, maniacal laugh suddenly erupts from the other side of the door.

steps.speaker: Alchemy Cauldron
steps.content: Bwahahaha! Almost there! Just a little more! My grand work is almost complete! I shall connect to reality! I shall manifest into reality!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...Yeah, someone's completely lost it.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: That's him!
The coin bank before you jolts as if electrified, its entire feline form poised to hurl itself through the door and fight to the death at a moment's notice.
